description: This file defines the 'OrderCriteria' class used for specifying filtering or query criteria related to orders, extending the generic 'Criteria' class, and including fields such as customerName, paymentMethod, and customerId.

classes.name: OrderCriteria
classes.description: A class that extends Criteria to include order-specific filtering fields like customerName, paymentMethod, and customerId.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method for the order criteria.

methods.name: getPaymentMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method set in the criteria.

methods.name: setCustomerName
methods.description: Sets the customer name for the order criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Retrieves the customer name from the criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID associated with the order criteria.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for the order criteria.
